cat > assemble.py << 'EOF'
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdCIPLabeler

def embed(smi, seed=42, nconf=1):
    m = Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
    AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m, numConfs=20, randomSeed=seed)
    res=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(m, maxIters=5000)
    best=min(range(len(res)), key=lambda i:res[i][1])
    conf=m.GetConformer(best)
    pos=np.array(conf.GetPositions())
    m2=Chem.Mol(m)
    m2.RemoveAllConformers()
    c=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
    for i,p in enumerate(pos): c.SetAtomPosition(i, p.tolist())
    m2.AddConformer(c, assignId=True)
    return m2

def kabsch(P, Q):
    # find R,t minimizing |R P + t - Q|
    pc=P.mean(0); qc=Q.mean(0)
    H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc)
    U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))
    D=np.diag([1,1,d])
    R=Vt.T@D@U.T
    return R, qc - R@pc

def rotmat(axis, ang):
    axis=axis/np.linalg.norm(axis)
    K=np.array([[0,-axis[2],axis[1]],[axis[2],0,-axis[0]],[-axis[1],axis[0],0]])
    return np.eye(3)+np.sin(ang)*K+(1-np.cos(ang))*K@K

# ============ Fragment 1: indenyl anion ============
smiA='Cc1[cH-]c2ccccc2c1-c1ccccc1'
A=embed(smiA, seed=7)
PA=np.array(A.GetConformer().GetPositions())
symA=[a.GetSymbol() for a in A.GetAtoms()]
# cp ring atoms: the 5-membered ring
ri=A.GetRingInfo()
cp=[r for r in ri.AtomRings() if len(r)==5][0]
print('cp ring', cp, [symA[i] for i in cp])
# centroid & normal
C=PA[list(cp)]
cen=C.mean(0)
u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(C-cen)
nrm=vt[2]
# build rotation mapping nrm->+z
def align_vec(a,b):
    a=a/np.linalg.norm(a); b=b/np.linalg.norm(b)
    v=np.cross(a,b); c=np.dot(a,b)
    if np.linalg.norm(v)<1e-8:
